Backlog after this run: 8 items pending (#12, #13, #14, #15, #16, #25, #32, #35).

Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked against live SERPs on 2026-06-05. NOTABLE REGRESSION: meridianosteopathy.co.nz dropped from non-aggregator #3 → not in top 10 for 'osteopath vs physiotherapist christchurch' (≥5 spot shift). The Ahrefs week-of-2026-05 study showed only 54.5% URL overlap between consecutive AI Overview responses, so this may reflect SERP volatility rather than structural ranking loss — monitor next run before concluding. Three first-time checks for queries added last run (rotator cuff osteopath christchurch, postnatal osteopath christchurch, chiropractor vs osteopath christchurch) — all absent from top 10. Chiropractor-vs-osteopath shows Better Health holds /resources/osteopath-vs-chiropractor/ at #1, same dedicated-comparison-URL pattern as Halswell's osteopath-vs-physio-vs-chiro post. NOTABLE POSITIVE: 'paediatric osteopath christchurch' AI summary now names Nina Hu directly with her @meridianosteopathy.co.nz email and 02108655151 phone — the entity-attribution layer is working even though our URL doesn't rank (the link is via happyspine.co.nz/nina-hu at SERP position 7). Four queries pruned this run (osteopath hillmorton, tmj osteopath christchurch, acupuncture for ivf christchurch, cranial osteopath christchurch — all below priority 20 for three consecutive runs). Five new derived queries added: 'acupuncture for endometriosis christchurch', 'acupuncture for pcos christchurch', 'acupuncture for cancer christchurch' (all three test Min Jin's new clinical-interest content from PR #98), 'headaches osteopath christchurch' (splits intent from migraines combo), and 'post concussion syndrome christchurch' (natural variant of post-concussion). Standard -10 decay applied across all 30 queries below top 10. Pool size 45/50.

Industry signals (week of 2026-05-29 → 2026-06-05): (1) **Google Search Console launched a Generative AI performance report on 2026-06-03** — tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity; opt-out toggle effective 2026-06-17. This is the first time we can directly measure AI-surface impressions for meridianosteopathy.co.nz — drives NEW item #35 (verify GSC account access and enable the report before the opt-out toggle goes live). (2) Ahrefs published a schema-impact study covering 1,885 pages that added JSON-LD between Aug 2025–Mar 2026 vs 4,000 controls — adding schema produced NO major uplift in citations on Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, or ChatGPT. Counterweight to schema-heavy advice: entity authority + content depth/freshness do the work, not schema markup. Reinforces #14 (blog) and tells us NOT to keep adding schema for its own sake; our existing MedicalClinic / MedicalCondition / Physician / Service / FAQPage / ReserveAction graph is sufficient. (3) SE Ranking 100,000-keyword study on the Gemini 3 AI Overview update (rolled default 2026-01-27): 42% of previously cited AIO domains have been replaced; each AIO now pulls 32% more sources per response; 88% of AIOs now cite three or more sources, only 1% cite a single source. Citation overlap with the organic top-10 collapsed from 76% (Jul-2025) to 17–38% — a citable rank-anywhere page is still the right strategy. (4) Conductor / CMSWire week-of-2026-05 data: Reddit citation share on Perplexity stabilising at 46.5%; ~5% on ChatGPT. Reinforces #15. (5) Local SEO update (week of 2026-05-29): reviews older than 18 months 'carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence — content and signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. Reinforces #16. Tier 1 → #35 (enable GSC Gen AI report). Tier 2 → #12, #13, #25, #32. Tier 3 → #14, #15, #16.

gaps.title: No blog / editorial content
gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. April-2026 industry data: 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within 30 days, 50% of Perplexity citations come from content less than 13 weeks old. osteopath-christchurch.com is winning headache/migraine/cranial/baby-osteo queries on blog-post velocity — 1 short post per condition is enough to claim those niches. MK Osteopathy is doing the same for TMJ. May-2026 BrightEdge / Healthcare Success data confirms the pattern is hardening: AI Overviews now trigger on 88% of healthcare queries (up from 72% in 2024), with cited brands earning 35% more clicks and AI visitors converting 4.4× higher than organic. Reinforced 2026-06-05 by Ahrefs schema study (1,885 pages adding JSON-LD vs 4,000 controls, Aug 2025–Mar 2026): adding schema produced NO major uplift in AI citations on any platform — entity authority + content depth/freshness do the work, not schema markup. Local SEO data this week: content updated within the past two months earns 28% more AI citations than older material. The case for blog freshness is now the strongest it has been since the audit started.

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit appears in 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable as of week of 2026-05-29) and ~5% of ChatGPT citations. Reddit is the second most visible website in Google search results in 2026 (only Wikipedia ahead) and is now the most-cited social domain across AI models. Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026, with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth across nine product categories. ClaudeBot crawl volume grew 800% at the start of 2026 as Anthropic scaled its web search API — Reddit citations are increasingly the path into Claude's answers too, not just Perplexity's. Item #15 still applies.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. NOTE 2026-06-05: Ahrefs schema-study (week-of-2026-05) found adding JSON-LD produced no major uplift in AI citations — so this is a low-impact-but-still-cheap item; do not over-prioritise.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. Reinforced this week (2026-06-05): local-SEO data shows reviews older than 18 months 'carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence; content and signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search per May-2026 PinMeTo / MedRankSEO data. May-2026 mapranks / icreatebrand confirm: Google is replacing Maps Q&A with Gemini-generated answers pulled from GBP + reviews + the clinic website, so review freshness now directly feeds the Maps-surface answer generation as well.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed again 2026-06-05: osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns the TMJ slot the same way. STRONGEST CASE YET FOR THIS ITEM 2026-06-05: Ahrefs published a schema-impact study covering 1,885 pages adding JSON-LD between Aug 2025–Mar 2026 vs 4,000 controls — adding schema produced NO major uplift in AI citations on AIO, AI Mode, or ChatGPT. That removes schema as a competing investment lever; content depth + freshness are doing the work. Per local-SEO week-of-2026-05 data, pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. With /admin CMS coverage now filled (PR #91), the editorial path is shorter than it was — adding a Decap blog collection would let the clinic publish without code changes.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. Reddit is 46.5% of Perplexity citations (stable week of 2026-05-29) and ~5% of ChatGPT citations, and the second most visible site in Google results overall (Wikipedia first). Tinuiti Q1 2026 data: social-media share of AI citations climbed past 9% Oct-2025 → Jan-2026 with Reddit accounting for the dominant share of that growth. Conductor research note: when LLMs do cite Reddit, sole-source citations rose 31% — Reddit is increasingly the only source for a given answer. ClaudeBot scaled 800% at start of 2026 — Reddit is increasingly the path into Claude's answers too. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. Reinforced 2026-05-02: Google's March 2026 core update now weights review recency AND owner response rate more heavily than raw count. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. May-2026 PinMeTo data: GBP is the primary data source for AI-driven local search across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity location queries. Reinforced 2026-06-05: local-SEO data this week confirms 'reviews older than 18 months carry diminishing weight' for AI citation confidence, and content/signals updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end.

Same gap reinforces 'acupuncture acc christchurch' (thehouseofacupuncture.co.nz/our-services/acc-acupuncture-chistchurch owns that one for the same structural reason). Build a short page (~500 words) explaining ACC-funded treatment at Meridian, the current ACC rate, no referral required, who lodges the claim (Nina, our osteopath; Min for acupuncture-specific claims), how to lodge, and link out to both service pages and a booking CTA. Low-effort content fix.

items.title: Add /conditions/concussion/ page — Triskelion Concussion Care owns 'concussion osteopath christchurch'
items.body: First check 2026-05-22 of 'concussion osteopath christchurch' showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz at #1, osteo.co.nz/concussion/ at #2, triskelionosteopathy.co.nz/concussion/ at #3; HeadWise (headwise.co.nz/who-we-are/andy-gibson) and Better Health (anastasia-mcpherson-osteopath-christchurch) also rank in the top 10, and Russell Johns at Moorhouse Osteopathic Centre is named explicitly in the AI summary. Reinforced 2026-06-05: same dominant set (Triskelion + Better Health + osteo.co.nz + Moorhouse + HeadWise + Halswell). 'Post concussion osteopath christchurch' continues to show the same pattern, and osteopath-christchurch.com now leads it with two post-concussion-migraines tag URLs. Concussion is high-value, ACC-adjacent injury content (post-concussion symptoms — headaches, dizziness, fatigue, brain fog — overlap directly with the headache/migraine and neck pain conditions we already treat) and a single-condition specialist site (Triskelion Concussion Care) is currently the strongest competitor. The smallest fix is a /conditions/concussion/ page that mirrors the existing condition-page pattern (sciatica, neck-pain, back-pain, headaches-migraines, pregnancy-back-pain, sports-injury-recovery): MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro (per #31's pattern), structured 5-7 item list blocks (per #34's pattern), acute-vs-chronic / when-to-seek-urgent-care / ACC eligibility / how osteopathy fits / book-now sections. Add a corresponding entry to conditions.json (including the new `lists` array structure introduced in #34) and a tile in the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Page exists pattern to copy; effort S.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report before opt-out toggle goes live
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. The opt-out toggle takes effect 2026-06-17 — sites are opted IN by default until then, after which an admin can disable AI-surface reporting. This is the first first-party way to measure AI-search visibility for meridianosteopathy.co.nz (citation overlap with the organic top-10 collapsed to 17–38% post-Gemini-3, so traditional rank tracking now misses the majority of the AI-surface story). Action items: (1) verify the clinic's GSC account has meridianosteopathy.co.nz as a verified property, (2) before 2026-06-17 check the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is left ON (default), (3) screenshot the first two weeks of baseline data to bank a 'pre-blog' reading before item #14 ships. No code changes needed. Reinforced by Search Engine Journal week-of-2026-05: Google's new AI search guide officially treats AEO and GEO as part of SEO, so the GSC report is intended to be the canonical measurement surface.
